messages:
Alex Chen: Heads-up — external pen-test vendor (Warden) penciled in week of 2026-05-11. Need to finalize scope, evidence handoff, and short ops checklist.
Jordan Patel: I can own the evidence handoff. Need exact S3 prefixes, presigned URLs config, and retention policy. Plan to create ephemeral role `assessor_readonly` with 8h TTL and MFA.
Maria Gomez: +1. We'll also provision a dedicated read-only CloudTrail/log-export bucket with lifecycle 30d and object-lock snapshots for evidence. @Alex can you confirm which services are in-scope? No analytics/staging.
Alex Chen: In-scope: api-prod, inference-prod, kms-proxy, console. Explicitly exclude internal analytics and dev clusters. No user-level PII may be included in exported artifacts — vendor must use redaction rules.
Sam Burke: For KMS access: do NOT grant decrypt. Vendor only needs KeyMetadata/List and Audit events. We should export KMS Admin audit to logs including key IDs. Example quick command for an audit bundle (vendor-facing):
```
# pseudo-example for ops
gcloud logging read "resource.type=cloud_kms_keyring" --project redwood-prod --limit 1000 > kms_audit.json
```
Jordan Patel: Ops note: presigned URLs should be HMAC + expire 48h. We'll also require SHA256 checksum on uploaded artifacts and enforce `content-md5` check.
warden-assess: Confirmed. Warden requests 72h access window during active testing and one 4h re-check for retest verification. Also request list of sample record patterns to avoid.
Maria Gomez: Retest cadence proposal: vendor does initial scan, we have 14 days for remediation, then a 72h retest window. If critical/urgent findings land, we can trigger an emergency retest earlier.
Alex Chen: I'll DM Warden the redaction rules and the final in-scope list. Also will add a short CSV of excluded API endpoints.
Jordan Patel: Tracking: I'll create a triage board PT-2026 in our issue tracker and use tags: severity, owner, fix-by, evidence-url. Please link tickets back here for coordination.
Sam Burke: Add a required evidence checklist for each ticket: repro steps, patch PR link, test logs, presigned artifact URL, timestamped snapshot.
Maria Gomez: Runbook for accidental service impact during test: vendor must pause immediately on detection, oncall page -> sec-incident channel -> rollback plan. ops will revoke ephemeral creds and isolate the test CIDR if needed.
sec-bot: snapshot-bot: created evidence-snapshot s3://redwood-pt-evidence/2487650123/snapshot-1.json (retention 30d)
Alex Chen: Action items: (1) Jordan to create assessor_readonly role + presign policy (2) Maria to provision export bucket + object-lock (3) Sam to produce KMS audit snippet + redaction rules (4) Alex to finalize scope with vendor and share CSV. ETA EOD tomorrow.
warden-assess: Thanks — we'll wait for the access package and the evidence checklist. Will not request decrypt privileges. :thumbsup:
